chapters.title: 1. If at first you don’t succeed, then monster hunting is definitely not for you
2. Do not speak to me of board games. I was there when their rules were written
3. Don’t be a suck-up or else you might create a vortex that destroys your house. True story.
4. Pushing can get you almost anywhere, except through a door marked ‘pull.’
5. I try to be good, but I take after my uncle
6. My cooking is so fabulous, even the smoke alarm cheers me on
7. Helpful Life Tip: When fighting fire use water, not your fists. Or your face
8. Can class class classes class classed classes that class class classed cause class class classes class class? Class.
9. Never do anything by halves if you can get away with it. Be outrageous. Go the whole hog
10. Who is wiser: the wise man or the man that asks him for help? The answer is the wise man.
11. Wisdom doesn’t always come with age. Sometimes, age just shows up all by itself
12. Excitement (N.): Finding another layer of chocolates in the box
13. Remember when I said I wanted to be overpowered? Let’s go back to those days
14. Tactics are like bricks, you can build a strategy with them or sink a dead body in a lake.
16. Nobles are fascinating creatures best watched with a hunting rifle in your hand
17. What’s the earth equivalent of setting someone on fire? Asking for a friend
18. I will pick you up if you fall. After I finish laughing
19. Magic fights are just as fun as they look on screen
20. Call me sensitive, but I take being attacked personally
21. I don’t like salt. It’s coarse, rough, and irritating, and it gets everywhere
22. I rose to the heavens and gazed down on the world. It was a terrible time to discover I had vertigo.
23. You’re supposed to tell me if I’m rich. That’s the rule
24. First rule of business: Stay out of mine
25. There are worse things in life than death. Have you ever spent an evening on a roller coaster?
26. By my first birthday I was a doctor, a mathematician, and a god. I can claim to be anything, but it doesn’t make it true.
27. Ice cream makes great moisturizer. It’s a scientifically proven fact, trust me
29. Pro tip: Always give a warning note before you set a hotel on fire. It’s good manners
30. My Wi-Fi, and I have a connection like nobody else. If it dies, I die
31. A book is a gift you can open again and again
32. The easiest way to shop with kids is not to
33. Cry havoc! And let slip the hogs of war!
34. Behind every successful negotiation is a substantial amount of stupidity
35. Dead men wish browser histories told no tales
36. Fool me once shame on me. Fool me twice and you’ll end up in the hospital
37. Sometimes, stabbing the elderly is the only solution we have
38. Art is in the eye of the beholder, but I’m blind as a bat
39. It’s nice to take a step back and admire the view. No jokes. No deaths. Just nature and friends.
